## Type of change

<!-- Tick all that apply. -->

- [ ] `feat` — new feature

- [ ] `refactor` — code change with no behaviour change

- [ ] `chore` — tooling, config, dependencies

## Checklist

- [ ] Title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (`feat:`, `fix:`, etc.)
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` passes
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes locally
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or `.env` values were committed
- [ ] Documentation updated when behaviour or env vars changed
